QuestInfo.name: Grako's Request 2
QuestInfo.1: You heard Grako's best friend #bMariwaka#k, who lives in Showa Town, is going through a rough time. You'd better check up on her!
QuestInfo.2: You met with Mariwaka, and she seems troubled.

0.0: Well, actually... There's something else I was hoping with you could help me with... My friend Mariwaka reached out a while ago to ask me for something, but I wasn't listening to what she said. She's my best friend, and I feel really bad about it... Do you think you could help me out and see what she needs? You can find her near the movie theater.

yes.0: Yay! Thank you! The movie theater is in the Showa street market.

no.0: You must be busy. Oh well, there's nothing I can do. If you get some free time, please help me out.

1.0: ...Did Grako ask you to see me?

yes.0: Grako... haha. Last time I saw her, she was acting all busy and stuff, you know... at least she remembers that I told her SOMETHING.
